source: Bluesky public AppView API, GET https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getPosts?uris=<remote_id>, read by plain HTTP without credentials; the returned record text is byte-equal to the approved content stored by ReachWeaver
reachweaver_event_log: approve, send_claimed, published (the owner's working install)
limits: Proves one text post sent through ReachWeaver on 2026-10-11 exists on the account. It says nothing about reach, growth or the other adapters.
